title: EUDI KYC Flow Designer
description: Design a wallet-based KYC onboarding flow with EUDI Wallet acceptance under eIDAS 2.0 (Reg (EU) 2024/1183). Maps presentation request, selective disclosure, AML CDD, and SCA compliance. FI SCA acceptance ~Dec 2027.
